section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Rear Window Defogger
title: Rear Window Defogger Wires

content.description: Diagram showing tester probe placement on rear window defogger with heat wire and tin foil

content.text:
• When cleaning the glass, use a soft, dry cloth, and wipe the glass in the direction of the wire. Take care not to damage the wires.
• Do not use detergents or glass cleaners with abrasive ingredients.
• When measuring voltage, wind a piece of tin foil around the tip of the negative probe and press the foil against the wire with your finger as shown.
INSPECTION OF REAR WINDOW DEFOGGER WIRES

content.description: Diagram showing voltmeter connection at center of rear window defogger wire

items.heading: INSPECT FOR WIRE BREAKAGE
substeps: (a) Turn the defogger switch to ON.
(b) Inspect the voltage at the center of each heat wire.

content.text: If there is 10V, the wire is broken between the center of the wire and positive (+) end. If there is no voltage, the wire is broken between the center of the wire and ground.

content.description: Diagram showing voltmeter testing for wire breakage point with broken wire showing several volts and 0 volt regions

items.heading: INSPECT FOR WIRE BREAKAGE POINT
substeps: (a) Place the voltmeter positive (+) lead against the defogger positive (+) terminal.
(b) Place the voltmeter negative (−) lead with the foil strip against the heat wire at the positive (+) terminal end and shift it toward the negative (−) terminal end.
(c) The point where the voltmeter reading deflects from zero to several volts is the place where the heat wire is broken.

content.text: If the heat wire is not broken, the voltmeter will indicate 0V at the positive (+) end of the heat wire but gradually increase to about 12V as the meter probe is moved to the other end.

content.description: Diagram showing repair agent application over broken wire with masking tape on both sides

content.text: REPAIR OF REAR WINDOW DEFOGGER WIRES

items.text: CLEAN BROKEN WIRE TIPS WITH WHITE GASOLINE

items.heading: PLACE MASKING TAPE ALONG BOTH SIDES OF WIRE TO BE REPAIRED
substeps: (a) Thoroughly mix the repair agent (Dupont paste No. 4817).
(b) Using a fine tip brush, apply a small amount to the wire.
(c) After a couple of minutes, remove the masking tape.
(d) Allow to stand at least 24 hours.

content.description: Two illustrations showing brush application of repair agent to wire and cross-section view of repaired wire
